description: Zulrah caps incoming damage at 50: a hitsplat that would exceed 50 is rerolled to a value in the 45 to 50 range instead.

quotes: Damage at Zulrah is capped at 50, with any hits greater than this amount dealing 45-50 damage instead.

description: The Fragment of Seren rerolls any hitsplat above 24 to a value in the 22 to 24 range. It is a replacement of the rolled damage rather than a clamp, so a hitsplat at or below 24 is left untouched.

quotes: ignoring whatever damage you rolled, and simply picking a number 22-24
Any hitsplats done to the boss above 24 damage will be re-rolled to 22-24 damage

description: Verzik Vitur's first phase rerolls any melee hitsplat above 10 to a value in the 0 to 10 range. Only an over-cap hitsplat is rerolled, so a sub-cap one is left untouched, and the Dawnbringer is exempt from the cap entirely.

quotes: Any hitsplats done to the boss with melee above 10 damage will be re-rolled to 0-10 damage
Dawnbringer - Has no damage cap on the boss.
melee is capped at 10 damage per hitsplat

description: The Ranged and Magic half of Verzik Vitur's first-phase cap: any hitsplat above 3 is rerolled to a value in the 0 to 3 range, with the Dawnbringer exempt.

quotes: Any hitsplats done to the boss with ranged or magic above 3 damage (excluding Dawnbringer) will be re-rolled to 0-3 damage.
Dawnbringer - Has no damage cap on the boss.

description: The Corporeal Beast caps a Corpbane weapon set to Stab at 100 damage per hitsplat. Ranged and non-Corpbane melee are halved instead, which is modelled separately as a damage reduction, and no source says that path retains the legacy cap of 50, so it is left uncapped here.

quotes: The damage cap of 50 for halberds and spears has been increased to 100.
Applies to Corpbane weapons set to Stab; ranged and non-Corpbane melee weapons have their damage reduced by 50%

description: The Leviathan caps damage at 10 while it is stunned. This applies away from the backside wound, which the calculator treats as its own situation.

quotes: Damage against it is capped at 10 when stunned
